narration.prompt: [whispers] Bente-tres kami sa bus. Pero bente-kuwatro ang bilang ni kuya. [long pause] [softly] Huling biyahe pahilaga, alas-dose ng gabi. Tulog na halos lahat. [long pause] Sa isang liko sa tabi ng bangin, may pumara. Babae. Mag-isa, walang dala. [long pause] Umupo siya sa likod ko. Basang-basa ang buhok niya. Pero hindi umuulan. [long pause] Lumapit si kuya para maningil. Pagtingin niya sa upuan... wala nang tao. [long pause] Inihinto ng driver ang bus. Binilang kami isa-isa. Bente-tres. [long pause] Pero yung sandalan sa likod ko, may lubog pa. At basa. [long pause] [whispers] Bumilang ulit si kuya. Pagdating sa akin, tumigil siya. Nakatingin siya sa likod ko.

bus-night-loop.prompt: Inside an old provincial bus driving at night on a mountain road: a low diesel engine drone, loose windows and panels rattling softly, air-conditioning hum, tires on worn asphalt, occasional creak of the body on curves, sleeping passengers, steady and lonely.

ticket-punch.prompt: A bus conductor's metal ticket puncher clicking sharply several times, one click at a time with pauses, coins jingling in his hand, inside a quiet bus.
ticket-punch.picked: punch-4 (no clipping; one click cut from its loudest onset)

brakes-door.prompt: A large old bus slowing down with a long squeal of air brakes and a pneumatic hiss, then the folding door clattering open, engine idling, crickets outside at night.
